params.body:
Follow-up to #896. Fixes bevinding transport-naar-hetzelfde-adres.

## A transport needs two addresses (R S4-10.23, new)

A request whose pick-up and delivery are the same address went through, got a price and could be paid; #896 only asked "Klopt dat?" in the window. One address twice is not a transport, so it is now an error, not a question.

- **Refused where it is made.** `TransportService::store` throws a validation error on `delivery_id` ("Het leveradres is hetzelfde als het ophaaladres. Kies een ander leveradres.", nl/fr/en/de/es) before anything is written: no transport, no change to an open request, and dimensions typed in the form do not land on the vehicle. The form shows it under the delivery address, like "verplicht".
- **One comparison.** The refusal, the window and the overview all ask `Transport::hasSameAddresses()` from #896 (street, number with addition, postcode, country; case, spaces and punctuation ignored; name and city do not count). No second copy.
- **Every creation path.** `TransportService::store` is the only place a transport is created: the request form, whether opened from the overview, an order row, a dealer transaction or the purchase mail (`?vId=`). There is no API route that creates one.
- **Existing same-address requests** (made before this rule) can be read and cancelled, never confirmed or paid:
  - the window shows the callout in the new error tone directly under the answer and has no primary button;
  - the overview row has no pay action and shows the state as it is. The overview query did not select the address columns, so the row could not have known; they are selected now;
  - `GET transports/pay/{uuid}` answers 422 with the message (new `errors/422` page in the visitor's language), without touching the state or creating a Mollie payment. Money Mollie already holds for an earlier attempt is still settled first;
  - cancelling works as before.

## The window, after review of #896

**Title per state** (the head of the window only; the overview badge and the truck keep the shared state palette):

| State | Title (nl) | Badge beside it |
|---|---|---|
| request form (new, or an open request being changed), `pending` | Transport aanvragen | no |
| `price_requested` | We vragen de prijs voor je transport op | no |
| `price_available`, `price_received` | Vraag nu je transport aan | no |
| `waiting_payment` | Betaal je transport | no |
| `paid`, `transport_requested`, `pickup_confirmed`, `completed`, `cancelled` | Je transport | yes, the state |
| payable but pick-up and delivery are one address | Je transport | yes, the state |
| an administrator reading another garage's transport | Transport | yes, the state |

The title and badge are one partial (`_modal/title`), swapped by the request step and by "Terug", so the head follows the step.

**Facts as a table.** `x-ui.facts` is now a quiet table by default: label left in grey, value right, a thin line between rows, one row height; on a phone the label sits above the value. A `label` prop names a group. The transport window uses three: Route, Wagen, Opties.

**Total.** `x-ui.total` is the last row of that table: "Totaal incl. 21% btw", the amount in the value column in tabular figures and 600, under a stronger line. It no longer floats at the two edges of the window.

**Order in the body:** answer, callout when there is one, table with the total as its last row, buttons.

**`x-ui.callout`** gains `tone="error"` (red, `role="alert"`); amber and grey stay. README updated.

## Notes

- The blocked message tells the dealer to cancel and request again, as specified. While a request is still editable, "Terug" also leads to the form, where another delivery address is accepted.
- A same-address request in `waiting_payment` with a checkout still open at Mollie can still be completed there; the webhook then marks it paid as for any transport. Only starting a payment from the platform is refused.
- `TransportChainTest`'s fixture gave the seller's pick-up location and the buyer's delivery location one address; they now differ.
- Rules: S4-10.22 rewritten (title, table, total), S4-10.23 added, S4-10.21 names the condition; finding `2026-10-01-transport-naar-hetzelfde-adres` (opgelost).

## Checked

- Full suite locally, PHPStan clean, Pint on the new files.
- By hand on a local demo database at 1440 and 390: the form with the field error, the window of a same-address request, the window of a normal request.
params.title: A transport needs two addresses: same pick-up and delivery is refused, and the window reads as a table
